data.title: THE STRUCTURAL ARGUMENT
data.source: Mearsheimer (2014). Why the Ukraine Crisis Is the West's Fault.
data.majorPremise: All great powers fear loss of regional dominance.
data.minorPremise: Russia is a great power with a claimed regional sphere.
data.conclusion: Russia will resist NATO expansion into its sphere.

data.title: THE LIBERAL COUNTER
data.source: Mearsheimer vs. Ikenberry — the great IR debate

thesis.label: REALIST THESIS
thesis.claim: Great-power competition is the permanent condition of international relations.

antithesis.label: LIBERAL ANTITHESIS
antithesis.claim: Institutions and economic interdependence dampen the security dilemma.

synthesis.label: BOUNDED SYNTHESIS
synthesis.claim: Competition is structural; its intensity varies with institutional embeddedness.
